verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer ships its own software tools (ChatGD, the D&O Questionnaire Portal, the Contract Generator, GDHQ), so asking whether their source is readable under an open license is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence shows any of these tools' source being published or openly licensed. The open-source item describes legal counsel offered to clients, not the firm's own code, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
